blocks.text: SOP: MySQL 8 schema change for inventory, expand then contract

This is the working cut for LSH-SOP-2024-044 on July 11, 2024. Greta Holm asked for a written bound after the current path (MySQL 8.0.36 on mysql-primary.lakeshore.internal) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host mysql-primary.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on drop column in the same release as readers, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Expand, backfill, dual-write, then contract next release. Lock budget 8s. No Helm rollback after an expand. I am not restating a hallway yes. drop column in the same release as readers is out because June 2023 sibling job taught this. Readers on old pods would 500. Next release drops. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at lock=8, ver=8.0.36, weeks=2, dual=1, drop=0, rows=18.4k, stores=4, freeze=Fri. Sibling tickets LSH-5420 and LSH-TDD-2022-022. I will not reopen drop column in the same release as readers in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: inv-api.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (40): refuse on drop column in the same release as readers, lock is expand/contract, 8s lock, no same-release drop. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-5420.
If you drop the old column in the same release as the readers, we will spend Saturday restoring.

What a skeptical user would try first on mysql-primary.lakeshore.internal: the path Greta Holm actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
